name: Card wallet
summary: A personal account: a card drawn in the brand colours with its number masked until you choose to show it, the balance, add money, send and a freeze switch, and recent transactions with a simple mark per merchant and a photo for people.
use: on the home screen of a personal banking or wallet app
a11y: Card details is a toggle button with aria-pressed and the masked number reads as "ending 4821"; Freeze card is a switch, and freezing disables Send and announces the change in a polite live region.

use_when: one card or account with a few quick actions and a short list of what it was spent on
avoid_when: a full statement with search, filters or many rows: use receipts-table
a points or loyalty balance: use rewards-card
saving towards a target: use savings-goal

parts.name: account
parts.what: the account name, the section's heading

parts.name: reveal
parts.what: a toggle that shows or masks the card number, expiry and CVC

parts.name: card
parts.what: the card drawn from the accent ramp, no image

parts.name: kind
parts.what: the card's name with its type below

parts.name: number
parts.what: the card number, masked to the last four until revealed

parts.name: card_meta
parts.what: expiry and CVC, masked until revealed

parts.name: frozen_veil
parts.what: the Frozen overlay shown over a frozen card

parts.name: status
parts.what: a live line that says the card was frozen or unfrozen

parts.name: send
parts.what: the second quick action, disabled while frozen

parts.name: freeze
parts.what: a switch that freezes and unfreezes the card

parts.name: recent_title
parts.what: the list heading and the period it covers

parts.name: transactions
parts.what: one transaction: a merchant icon or a person's photo, the name, category and time, and the amount

empty.how: with no transactions, keep the Recent heading and put one secondary line under it ('No payments yet this month')

loading.how: keep the card and buttons, show the balance and each transaction row as muted blocks of the same height

error.how: if freezing fails, put the switch back and write the reason in the status line, or an alert-banners notice above the actions

disabled.how: freezing disables Send and Card details, and both are drawn in the disabled colours

overflow.how: the transaction list grows without limit; cap it at five rows and add a 'See all' link under it

long_text.how: long merchant names end in an ellipsis; amounts and the card number never wrap

keyboard: Tab reaches Card details, Add money, Send and Freeze card in that order
Enter or Space on Card details shows or masks the full card number, expiry and CVC
Enter or Space on Freeze card freezes or unfreezes it; while frozen, Send and Card details are disabled and Tab skips them
